claims.statement: diffchecker-rs uses a two-process Tauri v2 architecture: a React 19 + TypeScript renderer in a WebView and a Rust main process exposing 20 capability-scoped Tauri commands for file I/O, diff computation, highlighting, merge, history, and settings.

The build pipeline uses Vite 8 for the renderer (output to dist/), cargo/tauri-cli for the Rust backend, and bun as package manager; `bun run dev:desktop` runs both with hot reload, `bun run build:desktop` produces platform installers.

All frontend-backend communication goes through Tauri commands via @tauri-apps/api/core::invoke(), with a typed DesktopAPI abstraction in src/platform/desktop.ts that gracefully degrades to web fallbacks (file input, local diff, highlight.js) when not in Tauri.

Shared types are single-sourced in Rust (src-tauri/src/types.rs) and exported via ts-rs to src/types/diff-generated.ts at build time, guaranteeing compile-time parity for DiffLine, DiffOptions, DiffResult, DiffType, CharDiff, DiffPrecision, DiffViewMode, FileContent, and DiffLimitError.

The security model restricts the renderer to zero filesystem access; all I/O goes through validated Rust commands with size limits (5 MiB/10k lines), path checks, and capability-scoped permissions in src-tauri/capabilities/default.json; the app works fully offline with no network access.

Local data (recent files max 10, history max 20 entries/20 MiB, settings) persists in ~/.config/diffchecker-desktop/ via atomic JSON writes with backup/rollback in store.rs, maintaining compatibility with the prior Electron app location.
